anya: quick flag – after the kernel-selector rollout yesterday (aot-optim), KV prefix hit-rate drops ~18% during autoscale spikes. 99p latency +60ms on affected pods. anyone tracking the same signal? :thinking:
kevin: yep saw it in grafana this morning. looks like batching window changes too. timeline lines up with the kernel switch at ~05:10Z. could be key normalization or token alignment shifting.
dmitri: dug into a few sample keys. the kernel change truncates tokenization at different boundaries so our old prefix hashing no longer lines up for ~30% of requests. example diff:```old_key = sha256(" ".join(tokens[:k+2]))
new_key = sha256(" ".join(tokens[:k]))```
liz: ouch. that explains the hit-rate drop. two quick mitigation paths: (A) run a deploy-time bootstrapper that replays recent real prefixes to KV shards (seeded from redis of hot prefixes), or (B) add a per-node scheduled prefill job on scale events. leaning (A) since it warms with realistic distributions.
sre-bot: deploy-bot: rollout aot-optim completed for cluster/us-east-1 at 2026-03-17T05:10:13Z :white_check_mark:
kevin: +1 for deploy bootstrapper. also propose a short-lived compatibility layer: compute both old_key and new_key for 24h then retire old_key once hit-rate stabilizes. cheap to add in runtime for reads only.
dmitri: agree. i'll prototype key-normalization shim. also propose adding a small probe that runs during pod init to validate hit-rate delta quickly:```/usr/local/bin/prober --seed-file /mnt/seed/prefixes.txt --mode check --report /tmp/probe.json```
ops-bot: ops-bot: example job to run one-off seed against service: `kubectl run kv-seeder --image=redwood/prober:canary --restart=OnFailure -- /bin/probe --keys-from /var/seedlist --rate 15/s --target svc/redwood-runtime`
anya: nice. action items: kevin -> prototype deploy-time bootstrapper + dual-key read; dmitri -> implement key-normalization shim + small init probe; liz -> write runbook for bootstrapper and rollback criteria (hit-rate back to baseline within 2hrs, 99p latency under +15ms). i'll coordinate schedule for a canary run tomorrow morning.
kevin: estimated 1 sprint for prototype, will open PR with config knobs for probe rate / shard fanout.
liz: will add runbook to ops-runbooks and tag eng-oncall.
anya: thanks — if we can get a probe + dual-key read in canary, we can limit user impact. :thumbsup:
